
```{python}
def read_book(path):
    with open(path, mode="r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
      return f.read()
  
eng = read_book("../data/english_alice.txt")
print(eng[:200])
```

```{python}
nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")

eng_doc = nlp(eng)

eng_lemmas = [(t.lemma_.lower(), t.pos_) for t in eng_doc
                  if not (t.is_stop or t.is_punct or t.is_space or t.like_num)]
                  
#data frame

#defining columns 
language = "english"
freq = Counter(eng_lemmas)
total_eng_tokens = len(eng_doc)
eng_lemmas_count = len(eng_lemmas)
eng_div = eng_lemmas_count / total_eng_tokens

df_freq = pd.DataFrame(
    [(language, total_eng_tokens, eng_div, lemma, pos, count) for (lemma, pos), count in freq.items()],
    columns=["language", "token count", "diversity", "lemma", "pos", "count"]
).sort_values("count", ascending=False)

print(df_freq.head(11))
```
